Agreement Title: Enterprise Hardware and Security Devices Supply Agreement
Date: March 5, 2024
Parties:
Client requested explicit reference to compliance with PCI DSS standards.
Vendor suggested adding optional disaster recovery hardware, Client requested mandatory inclusion for critical sites.

3.1 Vendor shall supply Hardware per Annexure A specifications.
3.2 Vendor shall conduct integration services and provide 3 weeks of on-site training.
3.3 Vendor shall implement cybersecurity configurations, including firewall and encryption protocols.
3.4 Vendor shall provide quarterly preventive maintenance and firmware updates.
Client requested SLA on firmware updates within 15 days of release.

4.1 Contract Value: $3,200,000 USD.
4.2 Payment Schedule:
25% advance on signing
50% upon acceptance of all Hardware
25% upon completion of integration and training
Vendor offered a 3% early payment discount; Client negotiated 2%.
Vendor offered a 3% early payment discount; Client negotiated 2%.

5.1 Hardware warranty for 36 months from date of acceptance.
5.2 On-site technical support within 24 hours for mission-critical devices.
5.3 Replacement of faulty Hardware within 7 business days.

6.1 Vendor shall ensure all Hardware and services comply with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and local cybersecurity regulations.
6.2 Vendor shall provide compliance certification within 30 days of request.

7.1 Vendor and Client shall maintain confidentiality of all sensitive information.
7.2 Vendor shall encrypt all data transmitted to and from Hardware.
7.3 Confidentiality obligations continue for 5 years post-termination.
Client requested 5 years (Vendor initially proposed 3 years).
Client requested 5 years (Vendor initially proposed 3 years).
8. Liability and Indemnification

8.1 Vendor shall indemnify Client for claims arising from hardware defects or gross negligence.
8.2 Vendor’s total liability capped at contract value; excludes indirect or consequential losses.
8.3 Vendor responsible for data loss caused by Vendor’s equipment malfunction; Client requested explicit inclusion of business interruption coverage.
